accuracy.screen_resolution: Samsung native panel resolution; exact aspect ratio
accuracy.screen_geometry: Published rectangular diagonal and exact native aspect; inferred bezels. Concentric corner radii, selfie aperture/notch dimensions are photo estimates.
accuracy.camera_geometry: Official rear-render normalized measurements; model-family housing/charging insert, separate glass windows, rims, apertures and flash. Protrusion and internal optics estimated, not OEM CAD.
accuracy.details: Rear wordmark and built-in charging surface where present; no S Pen accessory. Ports, speaker holes and antenna seams omitted. See research/samsung-tablet-rear-measurements.json for measurements and family transfer limits.
accuracy.finishes: Official names (regional availability varies); source-icon sampled/representative RGB, not measured material samples.
